designSummary: Time series of the measurement strand's primary proportion by term and by clinic day, with the conversation strand analysed separately.
sampleSize: About 1,900 children are screened per term and about 520 have an active cavity. With a baseline of 41 percent treated within 28 days, a rise to 60 percent in 520 children is estimated within about plus or minus 4 percentage points, and a p-chart of clinic-day proportions (subgroups of about 25 children) shows a shift after about four clinic days per school.
primaryAnalysis: p-chart of the 28-day proportion by clinic day across the 23 schools, with baseline limits from spring 2026 and pre-specified shift rules.
secondaryAnalysis: The same chart by home language; consent return times; chair and waiting times before and after cycle 3; refusals and complaints.
missingData: Children absent on the clinic day are counted as not treated within 28 days.
multiplicity: One primary measure per strand; no significance tests.
software: Spreadsheet p-chart template kept by the analyst.
